resources.string: Bound to the terminal connection that opened AI
No bound device connection. Connect a device, then open AI from that terminal.

Starting authorizes AI to act on this device for this task. High or unknown risks pause for confirmation. The task and redacted output go to your configured AI. Do not enter passwords. Leaving stops execution without auto-resume; commands already sent may have taken effect.
Describe one clear task, such as checking and enabling HTTPS management.
Stop requested. Commands already sent may have taken effect. Check device state; nothing will automatically resume or roll back.
Task ended. Review the execution and verification records above.
Task stopped due to an execution error, cancellation, or response timeout. Review existing records and check device state.

Do not submit passwords, keys, or credentials in tasks or ordinary answers. Web account passwords belong only in the dedicated local input; they are not sent to AI or stored in chat.

Use 8–64 characters with letters and digits. Whitespace, quotes, backslash, backtick, semicolon and question mark are not allowed.
